Creators, Gandhipuram, Coimbatore , for the position of Software Tester / QA Tester. We are looking for detail-oriented and technically interested candidates who can test web applications, identify bugs, verify application functionality, and ensure software quality across frontend and backend modules. Job Details Job Title: Software Tester / QA Tester Recruitment Agency: Softscholars Technologies Client Company: R.K. Creators Job Location: Gandhipuram, Coimbatore Qualification: Any Degree (B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT or related disciplines preferred) Experience: 0–1 Year Freshers: Can apply if they have relevant technical knowledge and testing aptitude Salary: Negotiable based on skills and suitability Joining: Immediate / Short Notice Preferred Required Knowledge & Skills Candidates should have basic knowledge or practical exposure to the following: Software Testing Fundamentals Manual Testing Functional Testing Regression Testing UI and Compatibility Testing Web Application Testing Bug Identification and Reporting Test Case and Test Scenario Preparation Basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript Basic understanding of React.js applications API Testing using Postman or similar tools Basic SQL / MySQL database queries Browser Developer Tools Additional Advantage: Knowledge of Automation Testing (Selenium, Playwright or Cypress) Basic understanding of Git and version control Knowledge of Agile / SDLC / STLC Experience testing React.js-based web applications Roles & Responsibilities Perform functional and manual testing of web applications. Basic understanding of web technologies. Interest in software testing and quality assurance. Ability to identify problems and think of different test scenarios. Willingness to learn new technologies, including React.js-based applications. Good communication and teamwork skills. Responsible attitude towards assigned tasks and deadlines. title: IN-Technical Architect - Consulting
description: Our current technical environment: Software: Core Java, PLSQL and Extjs What you’ll do: Understand business objectives and analyze customer requirements to propose effective technical solutions. Provide effort estimates and contribute to solution planning, design and delivery. Involved in solution design and design review processes to ensure alignment with business and technical objectives. Develop, code, and unit test high-quality solutions in accordance with established standards and best practices. Prepare and manage software releases, rollouts, and Hotfixes/patches, including release planning, scheduling, and creation of release notes. Provide technical inputs and high-level estimates (HLEs) to support pre-sales activities, including PRS responses like estimations and design workshops. Collaborate with customers and project teams to review requirements, specifications, and proposed solutions. Ensure all deliverables, including code and documentation, undergo peer reviews and follow up to ensure feedback is addressed. Perform risk assessments, prepare quotes, and define high-level functional and technical approaches for new software changes. Investigate, triage, and resolve defects and issues, providing code fixes and unit testing in compliance with defined SLAs. Provide on-site or remote support for go-live activities, dry runs, testing, and other deploymentrelated needs and work during customer time zones. Coordinate and deliver product or solution demonstrations to clients. What we are looking for: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or Engineering or other relevant disciplines (MCA, MSc in Computer Science etc.) Total Experience – 7.5 yrs to 10 yrs Experience with Java, Ext JS, Java Script, PL SQL Experience in API Design Development and Testing. Experience file transformations like JSON, XML etc. Prior experience with Blue Yonder / JDA / RedPrairie WMS or other WMS platforms is an added advantage. Experience in test management and test execution. Familiarity with Agile development methodologies. Use of AI Tools – Cursor AI, Replit AI, GitHub copilot In-depth knowledge of software development best practices, build processes, IDEs, and database tools (e.g., SQL Developer, SQL Management Studio). Strong experience with source code control systems such as GitHub, Jenkins… Proficiency in working with Windows, Linux, and Unix operating systems, including commandline usage. Working knowledge of JIRA for issue and project tracking Ability to evaluate competing solutions and make informed decisions to achieve optimal outcomes. Willingness to take ownership of end-to-end project delivery and provide technical guidance to assigned engineers. Confidence in making suggestions and recommendations for continuous improvement. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build strong professional relationships. Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and ensure seamless information flow. Proactively seeks assistance and feedback when appropriate to improve outcomes. Demonstrates consistent behavior aligned with Blue Yonder standards, values, and best practices. //ID009 Our Values If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values.
